issue.title: just _lint-toobig fails on two oversized test files
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `just _lint-toobig`

The user-requested standalone `just _lint-toobig` run exited 1. It reported `tests/ace/tui/test_agent_hijack_action.py` at 1,092 lines and `tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_post_paint_publication.py` at 1,201 lines, both above the 1,000-line limit. Split the test modules while preserving their coverage and import behavior, then rerun the standalone gate.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The gate compares static line counts to a fixed limit. This run reported 1,092 and 1,201 lines against 1,000, so the violations do not depend on timing or runtime conditions.

issue.creation_reason: The requested standalone gate confirmed deterministic line-limit violations outside this refactor. Recording the cleanup separately keeps those lint failures actionable.

payload.description: Check overlap with monitor hijack epic sase-1t2.11.1 during landing

payload.entry: Verified resolved upstream by the sase-1t2 land agent: tests/ace/tui/test_agent_hijack_action.py was split by 178f57cc91 (now 84 lines plus _ingress 408, _ledger 330, _pending 336) and tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_post_paint_publication.py by fbf8555011 (now 71 lines plus private modules). Both are under the 1,000-line toobig limit; the hijack half was also epic sase-1t2 DISCOVERED ISSUE #1.
